entry.title: Designing Stable Interfaces For Streaming Content
entry.summary: Streaming UIs are an easy concept on the surface, but are quite complicated in practice. There are many considerations that need to be accounted for, from layout shifts and motion preferences to proper markup and various states, that may not be instantly obvious.
